parts:
Hello,

I'm hosting my Shiny App on the Shiny Beta servers untill today I didn't had any problems but today I got this error when I was trying to run my app:

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application took too long to respond.

Does somebody know how to fix this?

I saw this thread: https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups#!topic/shiny-discuss/yXzNpy-1vow, but I dont even know how to get into root mode in the rstudio beta shiny server...

Thanks in advance!

Greetings

Thomas.

messages.subject: Re: An error has occurred The application failed to start. The application took too long to respond.
parts:
Just checking in - is this issue still occurring for you? If so, could give the URL to your app?

For apps that are hosted by RStudio (on glimmer.rstudio.com), you won't have root access to the machine; that's only for when you set up your own server.

-Winston
